description: This file defines the AOS_InvoicesViewEdit class, extending ViewEdit, responsible for managing the invoice editing view in a SugarCRM module. It includes methods to display the view and populate invoice template options from the database.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesViewEdit
classes.description: Controls the edit view for AOS Invoices, including populating invoice template options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to populate invoice templates before rendering.

methods.name: populateInvoiceTemplates
methods.description: Queries the database for invoice PDF templates and populates a list used in the view.
